encoding: String code: ON_UNLOCKED, ON_LOCKED, OFF, UNKNOWN. Numerical mapping: OFF=0.0, ON_UNLOCKED=1.0, ON_LOCKED=2.0, UNKNOWN=-1.0
extraction_rule: Extracted from system screen state broadcast received before or at camera activation

encoding: 3-State String: TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN. Numerical: TRUE=1.0, FALSE=0.0, UNKNOWN=-1.0
extraction_rule: TRUE if screen_state in [ON_UNLOCKED, ON_LOCKED, ON]; FALSE if OFF; UNKNOWN if missing

encoding: 3-State String: TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN. Numerical: TRUE=1.0, FALSE=0.0, UNKNOWN=-1.0
extraction_rule: TRUE if screen_state is ON_LOCKED; FALSE if ON_UNLOCKED; UNKNOWN if OFF or unverified

encoding: 3-State String: GRANTED, DENIED, UNVERIFIED. Numerical: GRANTED=1.0, DENIED=0.0, UNVERIFIED=-1.0
source_layer: Production CameraGuard (unprivileged sandbox cannot verify third-party runtime permissions)
extraction_rule: In production CameraGuard, strictly UNVERIFIED due to Android sandbox boundaries. In research harness, reflects internal target state

encoding: Boolean: true, false. Numerical: true=1.0, false=0.0
extraction_rule: Matches inferredPackageName against known camera/video communication packages or system camera intent

encoding: Integer ordinal: 0=NONE, 1=LOW, 2=MEDIUM, 3=HIGH. Numerical: 0.0..3.0
extraction_rule: Confidence rating assigned by UsageStats attribution heuristic based on event recency and window visibility

encoding: String code: USAGE_STATS_ACTIVITY_RESUMED, USAGE_STATS_ACTIVITY_PAUSED, CAMERA_APP_HEURISTIC, NONE, UNKNOWN. Numerical mapping: NONE=0.0, USAGE_STATS_ACTIVITY_RESUMED=1.0, USAGE_STATS_ACTIVITY_PAUSED=2.0, CAMERA_APP_HEURISTIC=3.0, UNKNOWN=-1.0
extraction_rule: Identification of heuristic method that attributed the camera acquisition event to a candidate package

encoding: Continuous Double: time delta in milliseconds. Missing/Unavailable sentinel: -1.0
extraction_rule: Time difference in milliseconds between the candidate app's last ACTIVITY_RESUMED event and the camera availability trigger. Clamped to >= 0.0 or -1.0 if no resume event

encoding: Integer: count of foreground transition events in 30s lookback window. Missing: 0
extraction_rule: Number of ACTIVITY_RESUMED / ACTIVITY_PAUSED transitions across all apps in preceding 30s. Indicates system activity/multitasking intensity

encoding: String: 0 (rear), 1 (front), UNKNOWN. Numerical mapping: 0=0.0, 1=1.0, UNKNOWN=-1.0
extraction_rule: Camera hardware identifier passed directly by Android CameraManager availability callback

encoding: 3-State String: TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN. Numerical: TRUE=1.0, FALSE=0.0, UNKNOWN=-1.0
extraction_rule: TRUE if LENS_FACING_BACK (id 0); FALSE if LENS_FACING_FRONT (id 1); UNKNOWN if unresolvable

encoding: Long integer: milliseconds. Missing: 0
source_layer: Test Harness / Room Event closure lifecycle
extraction_rule: Total elapsed time from camera acquisition until physical release. STRICT TEMPORAL LEAKAGE at T0

encoding: 3-State String: TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN. Numerical: TRUE=1.0, FALSE=0.0, UNKNOWN=-1.0
extraction_rule: TRUE if user clicked Start button in harness UI. Invisible to production CameraGuard across sandbox boundary

encoding: 3-State String: TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN. Numerical: TRUE=1.0, FALSE=0.0, UNKNOWN=-1.0
extraction_rule: TRUE if user clicked Stop button in harness UI. STRICT TEMPORAL & OBSERVABILITY LEAKAGE

encoding: String code: IDLE, RUNNING, STOPPING, ERROR, UNKNOWN
extraction_rule: Internal target app execution state. Invisible to production CameraGuard

encoding: Boolean: true, false
extraction_rule: TRUE if target app Camera Foreground Service was running. Invisible without privileged system inspection

encoding: Long integer: milliseconds. Missing/Unclosed: -1
extraction_rule: Time elapsed from trigger event until CAMERA_BECAME_AVAILABLE callback. STRICT TEMPORAL LEAKAGE

encoding: String code: FOREGROUND, BACKGROUND, UNKNOWN
extraction_rule: Target app window visibility at exact moment of trigger. Production has only UsageStats heuristic

encoding: Boolean: true, false
source_field: app_visibility transitioned to BACKGROUND while camera open
source_layer: Test Harness / CameraGuard Event log sequence
extraction_rule: TRUE if app moved to background after camera was acquired. Available only during session progression

encoding: Boolean: true, false
source_field: app_visibility transitioned back to FOREGROUND before close
source_layer: Test Harness / CameraGuard Event log sequence
extraction_rule: TRUE if backgrounded app returned to foreground before closing camera. STRICT TEMPORAL LEAKAGE
